**Scope:** the 8 original ground/decor WebPs only.  \
**QA branch:** `feature/es2-art-qa-biomes` (forked from integration HEAD `918b18296eeec74a15b9b03267e4cc25f9a2f407`).  \

Inspected the *original eight images* as full-size source-image previews. This is **not** a claim of real-browser gameplay review, human approval or decoded edge/alpha-pixel QA.

All 8 also satisfy their **existing** per-file maxBytes budgets and have RIFF file-length consistency. The technical results alone do **not** establish visually clean alpha gutters, native authored detail, seamless tile repeats or correct gameplay screenshots. File hashes are preserved verbatim in `manifest.json`.

## Reproducing the native-resolution blocker

`src/game/render/environment.ts` (`paintEnvironment`) currently draws each authored `ground` source at **384×384 world/screen draw units** from a **768×768** bitmap, so nominal pixel ratio is **2×**; an actual native-3× master requires **at least 1152×1152** at this maximum size.

The same consumer crops each `decor` atlas using `sourceSide = decor.naturalHeight = 96` and `(o.variant % 4) * sourceSide`; each source rectangle is **96×96** within a 384×96, four-cell atlas. It draws each crop at **110×110**, which enlarges the source (`96/110 ≈ 0.87×`), rather than using a native-3× **330×330** source cell; a four-cell replacement atlas would need **at least 1320×330** of newly authored real detail.

The four scene-only `*-scene@3x.webp` files co-located in this directory are **outside the 8-item workstream** and are not counted as passed, failed or replaced here. The separate `src/game/render/es2-biomes/index.ts` procedural biome renderer is also outside this workstream's owned files.

## Visual inspection observations — source images, not gameplay captures

- Blood Moon Cathedral: distinct dark red Gothic-stone floor and four architectural props visibly present.
- Cursed Forest: roots, rocks and moss floor and four distinct tree/organic props visibly present.
- Abyssal Necropolis: purple-lit cracked stone floor and four tomb/arch props visibly present.
- Celestial Rift: astral-blue fissured stone floor and four luminous ruin/spire props visibly present.
- Original sprite previews do not establish source/detail provenance from `assets/images/imgs1.png` / `imgs9.png`, edge pixel alpha cleanliness, alpha-frame padding or frame-to-frame motion. No animation continuity is asserted for the four distinct prop variants.
- Source manifest records floor edge statistics, but **actual 2×2 repeat rendering** at game Canvas zoom and visually objectionable seams have **not** been evaluated. Do not mark seam QA passed from that note.

## Remaining required work (no fictional acceptance)

1. Obtain/author **genuine** native-resolution detail, not an interpolated enlargement, for four ground tiles and four separate four-cell decor atlases while retaining the existing dark-fantasy silhouettes, palettes and gameplay geometry. Keep original images untouched until a verified replacement exists.
2. **RED:** add a resolution/source-geometry regression test that fails on the current 768px ground and 96px decor cells; record actual Vitest output. **GREEN:** commit each truly reauthored WebP into this owned directory first, then update the matching `manifest.json` dimensions, geometry, SHA-256, byte budgets and provenance. Run `pnpm test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm check-release`; do not disable unrelated production-art gates.
3. Integration owner must coordinate any changes needed in shared `production-world.ts`, `environment.ts`, `biomes/index.ts` and their existing tests **only after the artwork is committed**; preserve original collision/hazard behavior.
4. Capture real Vue/Canvas screenshots (desktop, mobile portrait and landscape, zoom/DPR) of 2×2 repeated tiles and all four prop variants in-game. Inspect pixel gutters, ground contact, hazard telegraphs, prop depth, HUD visibility and reduced-motion modes. Save source-to-runtime comparisons and relevant MP4 evidence, if needed.
5. Record individual review sign-off; until genuine native source, real-browser visual evidence and authorized human approval are available, keep `visual-review-required` / `needs-human-approval` unchanged. No merge into the integration branch or `develop` solely on this audit.

**Verification limitation:** This remote-only GitHub inspection recomputed binary metadata but did not run a local pnpm environment or real browser. Do not treat the lack of reported test failures as a green CI run.
